authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.note: The specification describes an IMAGEDEF parent as a hard owner. The observed R14 custom-class profile uses an offset soft pointer instead; do not relabel the observed role or infer native semantics.

source.provenance: ACadSharp sample; its checked-in script uses AutoCAD SAVEAS LT98. Exact producer build and original source provenance remain unverified; see p6-persubentmgr-acadsharp-cross-version-dxf-wire-conflict-2026-11-09.json.
source.fixturePolicy: External DWG is read locally only and is not committed.

independentPeer.observation: IMAGEDEF type 528 self 0x8C4 has bit boundary 459 and code-C offset 2 resolving to 0x8C2; two soft-pointer reactors resolve to 0x8C2 and 0x8C5. Its IMAGEDEF_REACTOR has class version 2 and relative soft owner 0x8C6.
independentPeer.limit: A peer read confirms the encoded role and values, not native create, clone, remove or WBLOCK semantics.

change: For R14 custom IMAGEDEF, inspect the owner at the R13/R14 RL boundary after self and EED rather than at bit zero; recognize observed code C only as KnownSoftPointerOwnerBackReference. The existing hasUnchangedRasterDwgSources guard still refuses this profile. R13, fixed IMAGEDEF and unobserved owner roles remain unchanged.

checks.generated: Locally authored R13/R14 wire controls test documented hard owner, R14 custom code C, exact owner/reactor/xdictionary spans, source mutation, wrong owner/reactor roles, arithmetic underflow, fixed-type refusal, truncation and retry.
checks.asan: Focused generated test passed with the instrumented library.
checks.original: Source capture now passes correlation and reaches explicit IMAGEDEF owner-back-reference qualification refusal; both ASCII and binary, strict and allow-partial CLI modes preserve pre-existing destination bytes.
checks.sourceLimit: The source also contains two ACAD_TABLE entity parse failures, four object parse failures and three unmodeled class instances; this is not successful partial conversion or complete support.
checks.baselineTest: Unmodified HEAD raster EED test reproduced the AC1027 whole-source-gate failure. Its updated matrix now verifies destination-preserving AC1027 refusal and continued source-mutation checks, while other admitted revisions retain output/readback and corrected retry.
checks.focusedRegression: Seven rebuilt focused raster wire, EED, source identity, custom class, reactor metadata, observer profile and observer-fault tests passed.
